exception.title: No venue-supported sandbox or private test order
exception.reason: Bitpanda Fusion does not provide an available non-production order path for this account; connectivity and order behavior cannot be validated with a test order.
exception.accepted_risk: The first production order is a small sell-only canary and may be filled, partially filled, rejected, or incur fees and slippage.

preconditions: Gate 1 operator verification confirms the active Bitpanda key is Activated.
Gate 1 operator verification confirms Read and Trade permissions.
Gate 1 operator verification confirms withdrawals and transfers are disabled or unavailable.
Gate 1 operator verification confirms the Railway static outbound IP whitelist.
Railway service is Online after the latest deployment.
BTC-EUR market feed is live and not stale.
Available BTC balance is sufficient for the Bitpanda minimum order and current price buffer.
Emergency-stop test and recovery test are recorded as PASS.
Gates 3, 4, 5, and 6 are recorded as PASS.
ORDER_JOURNAL_PATH is mounted on persistent storage at /app/data/orders.sqlite3.
A human operator approves this exception and the exact canary payload.

canary.purpose: Validate one controlled sell-only production order and its reconciliation.

reconciliation_requirements: Record exchange order ID and response.
Reconcile filled, partially filled, cancelled, rejected, or timed-out status.
Record all fills and fees in the durable journal.
Confirm local journal and Bitpanda status agree.
Confirm updated BTC and EUR balances.
Do not submit a second order after timeout until the first order is reconciled.

rollback.cancel_open_orders: Only after authenticated status review and using the kill-switch procedure.

evidence_required: Bitpanda key settings screenshot or operator attestation stored outside chat.
Railway deployment ID and Online status.
Read-only authentication response with secrets redacted.
Journal path and volume mount confirmation.
Canary order ID and reconciliation record, if executed.
